# 00000003898

**English.** Definition: The θ-map is the lift of Frobenius φ: A → A/I on prisms. Conjecture: The kernel of θ over Z_p[q] is generated by an Eisenstein polynomial E(q) whose leading coefficient has p-adic valuation exactly 1, and this Eisenstein property characterizes admissible choices of q. (theta kernel Eisenstein characterization)

**中文。** 定义：θ-映射指棱镜上 Frobenius φ: A → A/I 的提升。猜想：θ 的核在 Z_p[q] 上由 Eisenstein 多项式 E(q) 生成,首系数的 p-进赋值恰为 1,且该 Eisenstein 性刻画 q 的容许选取。（θ-核 Eisenstein 刻画）
